outcome: Give farm operations director / food quality head a governed method to improve feed cost per growth unit using nutrition specifications, ingredient costs and livestock stage, with final decisions…
overview: Feed Ration Cost Optimisation addresses resource allocation is planned in silos, producing avoidable delays and occasionally infeasible instructions in agriculture and food production operations. The first proof of value uses nutrition specifications, ingredient costs and livestock stage. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is feed cost per growth unit, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: nutrition specifications, ingredient costs and livestock stage; define feed cost per growth unit and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Farm Operations Director / Food Quality Head.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including replay disruption and edge cases with hard constraints enforced.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
deliverables: Agreed test threshold for feed cost per growth unit
